description:
A playable musical instrument for Mineclonia.

Express yourself musically:
Hold the recorder. Press movement keys. Make music.

Controls: W, A, S, D, Sneak, Sprint, Jump

Features: 7 notes, polyphonic chords, magic particles, craftable (2 sticks, left to right)

Summon Song:
Completely optional! If you have a Kodama (https://content.luanti.org/packages/_Krush/kodama_companion/)
you can play the summon song (C - E - G) on your recorder to call Kodama.
